FILTERFORM.ONLOAD: select @@datod as datod , (convert(varchar,year(getdate()))+'1231') as datdo,(select naziv from partneri where partneriid = convert(integer,(select VarSet from PubVars where VarIme = 'NasId'))) as tkosmomi,getdate() as datdanas, (select m.naziv from partneri p inner join parstru ps on ps.partneriid=p.partneriid inner join mjesta m on m.mjestaid=ps.mjestaid where p.partneriid = convert(integer,(select VarSet from PubVars where VarIme = 'NasId')) and ps.hqind='*') AS mjesto, '@@searchboxpartneriid' as ParNaziv
FILTERFORM.CAPTION: Parametri

INPUT.CAPTION: Konto:*
INPUT.NAME: kntplanaid
INPUT.SQL: select kp.kntplanaid,kp.konto+' '+kp.naziv as combo from kntplana kp inner join KntVrsta kv on kp.KntVrstaId=kv.kntvrstaid where kv.tablica in ('Fakture','FaktureDob','Kntostalo') order by combo

INPUT.NAME: partneriid
INPUT.CAPTION: Partner:*
INPUT.ONLOSTFOCUS: select naziv as nazivpartner,telefon1 as telefon,fax from vipartneri where partneriid=@@partneriid

INPUT.NAME: klpartneriid
INPUT.SQL: select kl.klpartneriid, kl.naziv from klpartneri kl order by naziv
INPUT.CAPTION: Klasa Partnera:*
